entities.summary: This list is a collection of the final resting sites of notable composers and musicians in the history of classical music. It includes photographs of the graves alongside notes providing some context or additional information. In cases where the grave has not been preserved or has been lost, the list includes the current location of the tombstone, plaque or memorial commemorating the burial place of the respective classical musician, if such a commemoration exists. The list is limited to composers, conductors, instrumentalists and other figures of significant fame, notability or importance in the classical music tradition who also have current Wikipedia articles.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Cementiri de Collserola is a significant regional historical site as it serves as a final resting place for notable composers and musicians in classical music history. This list provides context to the lives and contributions of these figures, offering insight into the evolution of classical music.
